# Title
Integrate Angular Material tables and layout

## Description
As a user, I want the application to use Angular Material components for a more consistent, responsive, and accessible design.

## Acceptance Criteria
- All lists (players, teams, transfers) use `MatTable`, `MatPaginator`, `MatSort`.
- Uniform theme and color palette.
- Pagination and sorting functional.

## Definition of Done
- Components compile without errors.
- Layout matches Material Design specs.

## Subtasks
- Install Angular Material.
- Update components with Material Data Tables.
- Apply custom theme in `styles.scss`.
